summary: Selects the timestamp/value written to a scoring field (offset 0x984) of the object in ecx. When the scoring gate flag dword_8AB6E4 equals 2, delegates to Delegation(&dword_8AB6EC) and stores the x87 result; otherwise stores the global default dbl_8AFEA0. Called by sub_4B3400 (0x004B3400).

operations.description: Branch on scoring gate flag dword_8AB6E4: take the delegation path when it equals 2, otherwise the default path.
Call Delegation(&dword_8AB6EC) to obtain the gate-specific value; the x87 result (a2) is consumed by the following store.
Store the delegated x87 result as a float into the scoring field at a1 + 0x984 (2436).
Default path: store the global double dbl_8AFEA0 as a float into the scoring field at a1 + 0x984 (2436).

unresolved: What Delegation computes for gate type 2, and the meaning of the global dword_8AB6EC it receives, are outside this function.
Whether the stored value is a timestamp, lap time, or score is unproven here.
The double dbl_8AFEA0 is used as a single-precision float here; its source (session time per prior analysis) is not established by this packet.
